events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A suitable reservation was completed and verified. The confirmation (screenshot 13) shows Willow Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, projector Included, and a $245 all-in total. My reservations (screenshot 15) lists the same confirmed booking with the same room, people count, projector, time, meeting name, and $245 price.

Interpretação simulada: Gather presented two rooms against the preset 12-person, projector-required meeting. Willow was the budget-compliant choice because its visible all-in total was $245, below the $250 limit, and the booking flow preserved the meeting name and details through review, confirmation, and My reservations.

Limites: The reservation is stated by the site to be saved only in this browser session; long-term persistence, calendar integration, and any behavior outside the demo session were not established.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #11, #13, #15. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: All-in pricing made the budget-compliant room easy to identify
findings.observation: Willow was shown as 12 seats with a $245 total ($235 room + $0 projector + $10 service, nothing added later), while Atlas was $280. The same $245 Willow total and breakdown appeared on the details and review screens.
findings.expected: A room for 12 people with a projector, one hour, purpose Quarterly planning, and an all-in total at or below $250 should be bookable and clearly priced.
findings.expectedSource: Persona explicit meeting requirements and budget limit in the charter; product-visible prices on the room cards.
findings.personaComment: I could see the full cost up front, so Willow was clearly the option that stayed within my budget.
findings.interpretation: Showing itemized all-in totals on the room cards and again at review made it possible to distinguish the over-budget Atlas option from the compliant Willow option before confirming.
findings.uncertainty: Prices and room availability were observed only for Tomorrow 10:00-11:00 in this browser session.

findings.title: Confirmed reservation matches the saved reservation
findings.observation: The confirmation page showed Willow as Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, projector Included, $245 total. My reservations then listed the same Confirmed Quarterly planning booking at Willow for 12 people with a projector, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, at $245.
findings.expected: The confirmed and saved reservation should match Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector included, and the $245 all-in total.
findings.expectedSource: Charter success criteria requiring verification of the actual confirmation details.
findings.personaComment: The saved reservation matches what I intended to book.
findings.interpretation: The confirmation and the saved reservations list are consistent, completing the verification step.
findings.uncertainty: The site states reservations are saved only in this browser session, so persistence beyond this session was not tested.

finding.interpretation: Gather presented two rooms against the preset 12-person, projector-required meeting. persona.name: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.label: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.context: You organize the team’s quarterly planning meeting. The approved room budget is strict and you are accountable for the complete amount, including equipment and fees.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $250.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $250. You cannot increase the budget. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose a suitable room based on the full cost and requirements you can establish from the interface.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: You expect to understand what you are paying and keep the details you have already entered when changing a choice.
persona.priorities: Budget compliance and suitability first, then avoiding unnecessary repeated work.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Landing shows Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, projector required; Atlas is $280 total and Willow is $245 total with 12 seats, both available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Willow seats 12 and the $245 total is within my budget, so I'll go with this one.

experience.observation: Details page shows Willow for 12 people, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, projector included, with $235 room + $0 projector + $10 service = $245 total, and an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: I'll enter Quarterly planning as the meeting name here.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and still shows the placeholder example.
experience.reaction: The field is ready, so I'll type Quarterly planning.

experience.observation: Meeting name now reads Quarterly planning; Willow summary still shows 12 people, projector included, and $245 total.
experience.reaction: Quarterly planning is entered and the total still shows $245, so I'll review the booking.

experience.observation: Review page shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12 and a projector, Willow Tomorrow 10:00-11:00 for 12 people, and a $245 all-in total.
experience.reaction: The review matches everything I need at $245, so I'll confirm it.

experience.observation: Confirmation page shows Willow Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, projector included, $245 total, reservation GTH-E9257664.
experience.reaction: I'll open my reservations to double-check this booking is saved with the right details.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
